# All Tool Master

> All Tool Master is a free online tools platform offering file converters, social media video downloaders, and AI-powered note-taking tools. No registration required. All tools run in the browser and are completely free.

## Tools Available

### File Converters
- PDF to Word: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/pdf-to-word

- DOCX to PDF: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/docx-to-pdf
- JPG to PNG: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/jpg-to-png
- PNG to JPG: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/png-to-jpg
- WebP to PNG: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/webp-to-png

- Video to Audio: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/video-to-audio

- Excel to PDF: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/excel-to-pdf
- HEIC to JPG: https://alltoolmaster.me/convert/heic-to-jpg

## About
All Tool Master is a browser-based, server-backed utility platform. All tools are free to use without signup or registration. Files are processed in secure temporary memory and immediately deleted after download. The platform uses Node.js with FFmpeg for media conversion and Google Gemini AI for AI-powered tools.

Built for students, professionals, and content creators who need fast, reliable file conversion, media downloading, and AI note-taking without paywalls or watermarks.

Launched: 2026
Built by: Vansh Shah (Mumbai, India)
